result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues related to content being truncated: one horizontally in the 'Fastest near you' carousel and one vertically at the bottom of the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: The third restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccoli') in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is partially cut off on the right edge of the screen, making the listing look broken and difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container has adequate right padding or peek styling so partially visible cards clearly indicate scrollability, or fully display cards within the viewport.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section (pizza image with '-20%' badge) is vertically truncated at the bottom, appearing cut off by the bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content area so the last card is fully visible above the fixed bottom navigation bar.
